clauses.reason: The sole paragraph restates sections 1(b) and 1(c) of Executive Order 11896: the Mission assists implementation of Annex I and its Appendix of the Treaty of Peace between Egypt and Israel by verifying zones and force levels and technical installations and conducting other assigned tasks, under policy guidance through the Assistant to the President for National Security Affairs and the supervision of the Secretary of State, and the Mission has the duty to ensure that the United States role enhances compliance in good faith. It has no sunset of its own. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 orders that the listed Executive Orders, "any amendments thereto, are revoked:" and lists the number 12227 in the No. column of its revocation table (offset 26818 of the held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12553.txt). This is an express revocation that names this order. EO 12553 has no effective-date wording, so the first-end date is its signing date, 1986-02-25; that is a reading of the text, not express wording, and the Federal Register publication date 1986-03-03 and filing date 1986-02-26 are not effective dates. Executive Order 12357 of 1982-04-06 adds new subsections to section 2 of EO 11896, does not touch sections 1(b) or 1(c), and its direction to terminate all Mission functions not later than 1982-09-30 is a disclosed not-later-than bound that names neither this order nor a completion date, so it is not adopted as the end.

research_rationale:
EO 12227 (signed 1980-07-22; 45 FR 49237) was read in full in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12227.txt. It restates sections 1(b) and 1(c) of Executive Order 11896 for the United States Sinai Support Mission. The dossier evidence ACT:EO:12227>EO:12553 (agent-located, independently reviewed) was re-read against the held EO 12553 text, whose revocation table lists 12227. EO 12357 (1982-04-06), read in full in its held Federal Register text, adds subsections (f), (g) and (h) to section 2 of EO 11896; it does not amend sections 1(b) or 1(c), does not name EO 12227 and does not revoke it. The LOOKUPS number search finds EO 12150 (an earlier amendment of section 1(b)) and EO 12357 as other orders citing EO 11896, and no held order other than EO 12553 names EO 12227. Machine searches read: U.S. Code 0 hits, eCFR 0 hits, Federal Register catalog 2 hits. Under the owner rulings of 2026-10-21 and 2026-10-28 the end is EO 12553 with EO 12357 disclosed as an earlier candidate.

savings.reason: Assistance given and verification performed by the Mission under the restated sections are accrued acts. EO 12357 section (h) assigns residual actions after September 30, 1982 to the Secretary of State, which is a later transfer of residual matters, not a command of this order. No continuing independent command of EO 12227 is held.
